capital.evidence_quote: Jerusalem is the seat of the government of Israel; most foreign embassies are located in Tel Aviv

currency.evidence_quote: The Israeli New Shekel (ILS, ₪) is the official currency of the State of Israel

timezone.evidence_quote: Israel operates on Israel Standard Time UTC+2, switching to UTC+3 during daylight saving time

voltage.evidence_quote: The standard domestic low-voltage electricity grid delivers 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national power network is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Sockets accommodate Israel's unique Type H three-pin plug as well as European standard Type C round two-pin plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 100 for emergency police response throughout Israel

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 101 for Magen David Adom national emergency medical service and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 102 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 112 serves as the international unified mobile redirect number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist assistance is integrated within standard police dispatch at 100

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Bölgesel çatışmalar, roket tehdidi ve güvenlik operasyonları nedeniyle seyahat planları gözden geçirilmeli; sınır bölgelerinden uzak durulmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Reconsider travel due to armed conflict and rocket fire; avoid border areas near Gaza and Lebanon.
advisory_headline.de: Reisen nach Israel sollten wegen bewaffneter Auseinandersetzungen und Raketenbeschuss überdacht werden.
advisory_headline.ru: Рекомендуется воздержаться от поездок в связи с военными действиями и угрозой ракетных обстрелов.
advisory_headline.es: Reconsidere viajar a Israel debido al conflicto armado y riesgo de cohetes; evite zonas fronterizas.

regional_warnings.area: Gaza envelope and borders with Lebanon and Syria
West Bank (excluding Bethlehem and Jericho with caution)

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Israel reach approximately 54.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds across major cities measure 140.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Border authorities issue a blue electronic entry card (B2 slip) instead of stamping passports, preventing entry complications in other Middle Eastern nations. Pelephone, Cellcom, and Partner offer tourist eSIMs.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Electronic entry card B2 is handed to arriving passengers and must be retained until departure

religion.evidence_quote: Israel is the historic homeland of Jewish culture and holy site for Abrahamic religions

festivals.value: Passover (Pesach), Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Hanukkah, Purim street carnivals
festivals.evidence_quote: Public life follows the Hebrew calendar with major holidays like Passover, Yom Kippur, and Sukkot

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Shabbat begins Friday afternoon and ends Saturday evening; public transport halts in most cities and shops close. Modest dress is strictly required at holy sites (Western Wall, Temple Mount, Church of the Holy Sepulchre). Keep the blue B2 entry slip safe.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Public transit and businesses pause observance of Shabbat from Friday sunset to Saturday night

tipping.value: Tipping 12-15% is standard practice in restaurants and cafés. Tips are rarely included on the bill and are usually added when paying by card or cash.
tipping.evidence_quote: It is customary to leave a tip of 12% to 15% in sit-down restaurants across Israel
